svg.aria-label: How a change on disk reaches the screen in mille: watcher, store and host in a utility process, then a mirror and the FileTree in the renderer
svg.title: How a change on disk reaches the screen in mille: watcher, store and host in a utility process, then a mirror and the FileTree in the renderer
svg.desc: Two processes left to right. A utility process holds the engine, Rust under Node: the watcher receives OS file events, the store is the one writer, and the host keeps a viewport per window. A MessagePort carries the change to the renderer, where the mirror publishes a frozen snapshot and the FileTree draws the rows on screen. Electron main only hands over the port, once; rows that are off screen are sent as ids only, with no records.
